info.cls_ename: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

description.describe_ch: 材料物理性質為材料科學與工程專業的基礎知識。從描述原子的電子物理與化學行為出發，透過化學鍵結模型與量子力學的架構分別來解釋材料的光、電、磁、機械、熱力、化學等物理性質的內容與關聯性。幫助學生了解金屬、半導體與絕緣體的電子導電行為、各種光學及磁性、半導體元件及光電材料之材料特性應用。
description.describe_eh: Physical properties of materials are rather essential to those who are interested in materials science and engineering (MSE) field. Based on chemical bonding and quantum mechanics, descriptions and relationships of basic physical and chemical properties of materials in photonic, electrical, magnetic, mechanical, thermodynamic, chemical aspects will be given. Students will learn electronic conductivity behaviors of metals, semiconductors and insulators such that they will grasp concepts of materials properties and their uses.

  3. 凡是學生曲解自己的學習任務、或損害學術任務之不端正行為，包括在作業或考試中作弊、剽竊、串改；或將他人完成的作品作為自己的作品；或未經教師批准和同意，提交相同或相似的論文、報告，以滿足多門課程的要求；凡被認定有學術不端行為的學生，其學業成績將扣分，若第二次勸說不聽者，該學期成績以不及格計算，並依本校學生獎懲辦法提報處分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• In accordance with academic ethics, it is important to adhere to the proper usage of instructor teaching materials. These materials are the intellectual property of the course instructors and should not be altered, disseminated, or sold without their explicit permission.
  • During assessments, if you copy answers from others or submit a thesis or assignment that is wholly or partially written by someone else, it will be considered cheating.
  • Any misconduct that distorts one's own learning tasks or undermines academic integrity, including cheating, plagiarism, or tampering with assignments or exams; presenting others' completed work as one's own; submitting identical or similar papers or reports without the teacher's approval to fulfill requirements for multiple courses—students found to have engaged in academic misconduct will have their academic scores deducted. If they do not heed warnings after the first instance, their semester grade will be calculated as a failing grade, and the case will be reported for disciplinary action in accordance with the university's student disciplinary regulations.
